findings: Synthetic feature statuses such as planned_q2, planned_q3, and in_progress read as roadmap commitments.
Roadmap output instructed acceleration and priority choices without a product-owner validation gate.
fixes: Replaced commitment-like statuses with candidate_for_review and evidence_under_review.
Changed recommendations to review candidates and added no-roadmap, no-ticket, no-outreach, and no-account-action boundaries.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
